final: WITH by_name AS (SELECT r.name, AVG(ds.points) AS avg_points, COUNT(*) AS standings_count FROM driverStandings AS ds JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = ds.raceId GROUP BY r.name), overall AS (SELECT AVG(standings_count) AS avg_count FROM by_name) SELECT AVG(b.avg_points), AVG(b.standings_count), AVG(b.standings_count - o.avg_count) FROM by_name AS b CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE b.standings_count > o.avg_count
